source: Derived 2026-10-07 from grok-inventory.json for the private-headers/gzip candidate; no new provider observation was made. The header names and observationSha256/observedAt below describe that earlier observation. review: Header names only: the body is no longer held to an observed per-field shape. tools/tee-native/inventory.mjs refuses before reveal any response header name not listed here and any credential in the body, meaning a non-empty string under a credential-named key or a string in a known credential format. The complete body is disclosed only inside the measured enclave, and the schema's selector and checks judge every field a decision reads. Set-Cookie values remain hidden; HTTP/1.1 framing headers are allowed. The route is filtered to SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS_ACTIVE with no fallback, and the schema's selector caps the items at four (grok-plan.v2.json), so a longer history still fails closed rather than costing more. Derived from the redacted-class inventory for the private-headers/gzip candidate; the only additions are the content-encoding (and vary) response header names. Header NAMES stay public under this disclosure policy and are still allowlisted here; every non-framing VALUE is hidden.
